ohio-aps-hotline.name: Ohio Adult Protective Services hotline
ohio-aps-hotline.use: Report abuse, neglect or exploitation of an adult age 60 or older. You can report without giving your name.

source.title: Ohio Adult Protective Services
source.publisher: Ohio Department of Job and Family Services

eldercare-locator.name: Eldercare Locator
eldercare-locator.use: Call or text. Trained staff connect older adults and families with local services in any state.

source.title: Find Help or Report Abuse (Elder Justice Initiative)

elder-fraud-hotline.name: National Elder Fraud Hotline
elder-fraud-hotline.hours: 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern, Monday to Friday
elder-fraud-hotline.use: Scams and money taken from an older adult.

source.title: Find Help or Report Abuse (Elder Justice Initiative)

va-justice-outreach.name: VA Veterans Justice Outreach
va-justice-outreach.use: VA staff who work with veterans in courts and local jails, and with veterans leaving prison (Health Care for Re-entry Veterans).

source.title: Veterans Justice Outreach Program; Health Care for Re-entry Veterans

incarcerated-compensation-rule.name: VA compensation during incarceration
incarcerated-compensation-rule.use: A veteran held more than 60 days for a felony conviction has VA compensation reduced starting on day 61. Family members may be able to receive part of it (an apportionment). Payments can resume after release.

source.title: 38 CFR 3.665, Incarcerated beneficiaries and fugitive felons: compensation
